id_permutation_checks: Exact semantic observations matched for both families in all 3 restored replay checkpoints. Controls preserve the prior six-checkpoint checks.

preregistration.ci: Percentile 95% paired bootstrap over validation task IDs, keeping both wording families and all three training seeds together in each cluster. Conditional on these three fixed training seeds; not a seed-population CI. Report replay versus baseline and replay versus all_task_diversity; no multiplicity adjustment.

control_import.validation_match: Full frozen row equality including IDs, requests, candidate sets and labels; all raw control predictions aligned by ID and target.

preregistration.decision: Exactly one 50/50 read-replay treatment and three fixed final-step checkpoints. Controls imported verbatim, not retrained. No validation selection or further variants. Mixed or uncertain read recovery/comparison retention is inconclusive; a CI crossing zero does not prove noninferiority.

train.sample_encoding: sorted compact ensure_ascii JSON per LF line, final LF
train.scope: iterative synthetic development only; no audit or held-out generalization claim

validation.sample_encoding: sorted compact ensure_ascii JSON per LF line, final LF
validation.scope: iterative synthetic development only; no audit or held-out generalization claim

preregistration.primary_measure: Old-family read exact-target recovery versus all_task_diversity, with baseline comparison to quantify residual read regression. Comparison retention assessed against both controls in both wording families.

read_replay.allocation: First 100 read worlds in generator order retain original wording; last 100 use the existing cyclic six-template assignments. Same fixed dataset in all seeds.
read_replay.explain_compare: Identical to all_task_diversity control; 200 worlds each.
read_replay.overlap_note: The six diverse templates include wording that can equal original wording. Allocation counts refer to recipe assignment, not necessarily distinct text.

preregistration.scope: CPU only, 2 intraop threads/1 interop thread; no GPU/network/spend/Index/test data/teacher API. Synthetic iterative development only. Targets select kind/field/entity/order, not answer values; no production planner or interface changes.
